column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“Jealousy great” is rendered “exceedingly,” and “rage great” “great wrath.”
“I have returned” is rendered “I will return”; “faithfulness” is rendered “Truth,” and NASB supplies “will be called.”
“Open places” is rendered “streets,” and “from abundance of days” “because of age.”
“Open places” is rendered “streets.”
“Difficult” is rendered “too difficult.”
“The setting of the sun” is rendered “the west.”
“Bring” is rendered “bring back,” and “faithfulness” “truth.”
NASB supplies “those who spoke” and “to the end that”; “founded” is rendered “the foundation … was laid.”
“The opponent” is rendered “his enemies,” and “each on his neighbor” “one against another.”
NASB supplies “treat.”
“The seed of peace” is rendered “there will be peace for the seed”; the meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Planned” is rendered “purposed,” and “ancestors” “fathers.”
“I have returned, I have planned” is rendered “I have again purposed.”
“Faithfulness and justice of peace” is rendered “truth and judgment for peace.”
“Harm” is rendered “evil,” and “an oath of falsehood” “perjury.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Appointed feasts good” is rendered “cheerful feasts”; NASB supplies “months” and “so.”
“Yet this” is rendered “It will yet be that”; NASB adds “even.”
“Steadfastly go” is rendered “go at once,” and “entreat the face” “entreat the favor.”
“Entreat the face” is rendered “entreat the favor.”
“Take hold … take hold” is rendered “grasp” once; “people” is rendered “men,” and “tongues of the nations” “the nations.”
